mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_NOTIFICATION ( NOTIFICATION_ID, RECEIVER_ID, STUDY_ID, TYPE, MESSAGE, IS_READ, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_NOTIFICATION.NEXTVAL, #{receiverId}, #{studyId}, #{type}, #{message}, 'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID AS notificationId, RECEIVER_ID AS receiverId, STUDY_ID AS studyId, TYPE AS type, MESSAGE AS message, IS_READ AS readYn, REG_DATE AS regDate FROM TB_NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{_parameter} ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC
